mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, product_title, product_cover, price, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productTitle}, #{productCover}, #{price}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, product_id, product_title, product_cover, price, quantity FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
